authorization.rationale: One bounded record-free Wiley health gate followed only by its predeclared interface/parser/control/completeness diagnostics.

diagnostic_date_bound.label: pilot execution-date diagnostic upper bound only; not P-001 and not a final common cutoff

review_state.source_free_query_policy: Use the existing AllField query files byte-for-byte; no regeneration or semantic edit.

browser_contract.global_pacing: One exclusive shared-CfT lease; 3 seconds between completed source invocations; no busy reissue is authorized.
browser_contract.cleanup: Remain attached through adapter-owned-page closure, baseline-anchor verification, and lease release.

operations.condition: Always first; a nonzero adapter exit, lease/browser/version/anchor/power failure, access/challenge/login, service/syntax error, rewrite, missing/conflicting total, wrong route, or output collision stops the phase.
Only after OP-01 passes; long-query parser and controls.
Only after OP-02 passes; separate Collections boundary and total.
Only after OP-01..OP-03 pass and OP-01 total is 1..40; limit equals OP-01 total and max-pages equals ceil(total/20). If OP-01 total is zero or >40, OP-04 is not run.

stop_conditions: Never retry a failed operation in this attempt.

Any access/challenge/login, busy condition without an authorized retry, syntax/rewrite/control/route/total failure, stale or short page, duplicate/missing DOI, pass drift, RIS mismatch, output collision, nonzero adapter exit, or unresolved cleanup stops fail-closed.
Failure totals are null; only a positively reconciled native zero may be recorded as zero.
No screening, relevance assessment, candidate import, final event, pair-bearing cell submission, fallback query, or semantic/protocol change.

artifact_policy.restricted_material: Raw Wiley JSON/CSV, native RIS, page/DOM text, screenshots, source-state URLs, and record-level identifiers remain outside Git under the restricted root.
artifact_policy.count_only_record_policy: Operations 1-3 retain no bibliographic records; operation 4, if enacted, is diagnostic only and never imported.
